extensionDescription.message: Translate manga through the Koharu Manga Translation Backend REST API.

extensionTagline.message: A quiet workspace for translated pages

footerPrivacy.message: Images travel only to your configured backend.

pageAccessEnabled.message: Page translation is enabled for this site.

pageAccessDescription.message: Enable the in-page manga detector for this site.

pageAccessUnavailable.message: Page translation is unavailable on this browser page.

sourceAccessDescription.message: Translation needs access to $COUNT$ image origins.

apiBaseUrlHelp.message: The URL must end in /api/v1. A host permission may be requested when you save.

bearerTokenPlaceholder.message: Leave blank when authentication is disabled

bearerTokenHelp.message: Stored only in extension-local storage and hidden from page scripts.

comicCrawlerEnabledHelp.message: Optional. Approved adapters take priority; failures fall back to page scanning.

comicCrawlerAutoApplyPreviousHelp.message: When a page is recognized as a translated chapter, apply its successful matching job without opening the workspace.

comicCrawlerAuthHelp.message: Credentials are stored only in extension-local storage and are never shown to the page.

browserClientCredentialsHelp.message: Used for SDK enrollment and authenticated ComicCrawler REST requests. Leave both blank only when the server uses public mode.

browserClientDiscoveryConfirm.message: No approved chapter-image adapter matches this page. Ask ComicCrawler to queue adapter discovery for this one page? Generated drafts still require review in ComicCrawler WebUI.

browserClientVerificationHelp.message: Complete the verification in the approved tab. The extension checks the page and resumes the task after the challenge disappears, but never solves CAPTCHA.

browserClientRecovery_browser_disconnect.message: The Browser Client is disconnected. Background recovery will keep trying to reconnect.

browserClientRecovery_resource_unavailab.message: The task's approved tab resource is no longer available. Open its target URL, then recover the task with the current tab.

browserClientRecovery_worker_changed.message: The Browser Worker changed after the task started. Open its target URL, then explicitly rebind the task to the current tab.

browserClientDiscoveryHelp.message: Adapter discovery was queued. Review and approve the draft in ComicCrawler WebUI.

crawlerTaskState_verification_completed.message: Verification completed · create the task again

popupEmptyDescription.message: Open a manga page and use the on-page translator to select images.

pageImageReviewDescription.message: Inspect, exclude, and reorder the loaded images before sending them to your configured backend.

noPageImages.message: No loaded comic images were detected.

adapterNotFound.message: ComicCrawler has no adapter for this site. Generic page scanning remains available.

adapterCapabilityMismatch.message: This site's adapter does not support chapter images. Generic page scanning remains available.

adapterDiscoveryReviewHelp.message: Only the current page and the specific-chapters feature are supported for now. Review the generated draft in ComicCrawler WebUI.

confirmAdapterDiscovery.message: Ask ComicCrawler and AO to generate a specific-chapters adapter from this one current page? The draft is not activated automatically and must be reviewed in ComicCrawler WebUI.

discoveryQueued.message: Adapter discovery queued: $ID$. Review it in ComicCrawler WebUI.

preflightDescription.message: The backend accepted these images. Move any page that is out of order before queueing translation.

noAcceptedImages.message: No images were accepted. Review the rejected-file details and start a new upload.

translationDescription.message: These identifiers bind the result to one publication. A queued response is not a completed translation.

translationTargetHelp.message: Choose an LLM or Machine Translation target. Provider credentials remain on the host.

translationTargetInvalid.message: The selected provider/model is unavailable or does not support the target language.

quickModeDetail.message: Direct translation without AO or reference-style learning.

missingJobTitle.message: This job no longer exists on the backend

missingJobDescription.message: The extension restored job $ID$ from local history, but the configured backend returned 404. It may have been removed, or this may be a different backend data store.

jobWaitingDetail.message: This job is waiting, not failed. Live monitoring will continue.

artifactsEmpty.message: The job finished without downloadable artifacts.

artifactsWaiting.message: Artifacts will appear when the backend persists them.

eventsEmpty.message: Waiting for the first persisted event.

clearJobHistoryConfirm.message: Clear all local job history? Backend jobs and files will not be deleted.

jobHistoryLocalOnly.message: Only local history is cleared; backend data is kept.

errorBackendUnreachable.message: The configured backend could not be reached. Check the URL, container, and extension CORS origin.

errorUploadCanceled.message: Upload canceled. The backend upload ID is retained for inspection.

error_unsupported_protocol.message: The API URL must use HTTP or HTTPS.

error_versioned_route_required.message: The API URL must end in /api/v1.

error_host_permission_denied.message: Host access was not granted, so the backend setting was not saved.

error_settings_not_loaded.message: Backend settings are not loaded yet.

error_comicCrawler_browser_credentials_i.message: Enter both the ComicCrawler user ID and user API token, or leave both blank for public mode.

error_comicCrawler_browser_not_connected.message: Connect the ComicCrawler Browser Client first.

error_comicCrawler_browser_tab_not_regis.message: Approve the current tab again before creating a task.

error_comicCrawler_browser_no_verificati.message: This task has no active verification handoff.

error_comicCrawler_browser_verification_.message: The approved tab still shows a verification or blocked page. Complete it in that tab; background checking will continue automatically.

error_comicCrawler_browser_no_task.message: There is no current ComicCrawler task.

error_comicCrawler_browser_task_not_reco.message: This ComicCrawler task is not in a recoverable Browser-target state.

error_comicCrawler_browser_recovery_wron.message: Open the task's target or verification URL in the current tab before recovering it.

error_comicCrawler_browser_rebind_not_fo.message: ComicCrawler no longer has this task. Refresh or clear the local task reference.

error_comicCrawler_browser_rebind_forbid.message: The current ComicCrawler user does not own this task or Browser target.

error_comicCrawler_browser_rebind_invali.message: The task changed to a state that cannot be recovered. Refresh its status before trying again.

error_comicCrawler_browser_rebind_stale_.message: The task's Browser target changed after it was loaded. Refresh the task before trying again.

error_comicCrawler_browser_rebind_invali.message: ComicCrawler rejected the new Browser target. Check that the Worker is idle and the current page matches the task.

error_comicCrawler_browser_task_not_canc.message: ComicCrawler does not expose a cancellation API for this discovery record. Review it in ComicCrawler WebUI or clear the local reference.

error_comicCrawler_browser_user_gesture_.message: Open the extension popup and perform this action there.

error_current_tab_inaccessible.message: The current tab is unavailable or is not an HTTP/HTTPS page.

error_backend_health_unavailable.message: The backend health response did not report ready.

error_backend_not_ready.message: The backend runtime is not ready.

error_koharu_not_ready.message: Koharu is not running. Start it on the host, then check again.

error_no_images_selected.message: Choose at least one source image.

error_translation_target_incomplete.message: Choose both a translation provider and model.

error_crawler_source_unavailable.message: The ComicCrawler image source is unavailable.

error_page_image_fetch_failed.message: An image could not be read from the page.

error_source_page_mapping_incomplete.message: ComicCrawler could not map every saved translation to the current chapter pages, so it was not applied automatically.

error_source_page_changed.message: ComicCrawler detected that a source manga page changed, so the older translation was not applied automatically.

error_artifact_not_image.message: This artifact is not an image and cannot be applied inline.

error_artifact_not_image_or_zip.message: The translated artifact is neither an image nor a ZIP archive.

error_artifact_zip_invalid.message: The translated ZIP archive could not be extracted.

error_artifact_zip_has_no_images.message: The translated ZIP archive contains no supported images.

error_artifact_image_count_mismatch.message: The number of translated images does not match the selected page images, so no automatic replacement was made.

error_inline_replacement_incomplete.message: Not every source image could be found on the page. Any partial replacements were restored.

error_inline_restore_failed.message: The original page images could not be restored. Reload the page and try again.

error_translated_images_contract_invalid.message: The backend returned an invalid translated-image manifest.

error_translated_image_content_invalid.message: The backend translated-image endpoint did not return an image.

error_artifact_read_failed.message: The translated image artifact could not be read.

error_comicCrawler_network.message: ComicCrawler could not be reached. Generic page scanning remains available.

error_comicCrawler_api.message: ComicCrawler rejected the request. Check its service and authentication settings.

error_comicCrawler_unavailable.message: ComicCrawler's chapter-image API is unavailable or did not finish in time. Generic page scanning is being used.

error_source_host_permission_required.message: Image-source access is required. Open the extension popup, select “Allow image sources,” then translate again.

warning_comicCrawler_network.message: ComicCrawler could not be reached; using generic page scanning.

warning_comicCrawler_api.message: ComicCrawler rejected image discovery; using generic page scanning.

warning_comicCrawler_contract.message: ComicCrawler returned an unsupported response; using generic page scanning.

warning_comicCrawler_unavailable.message: ComicCrawler chapter-image detection is unavailable or did not finish in time; using generic page scanning.

warning_comicCrawler_timeout.message: ComicCrawler chapter-image extraction exceeded 45 seconds, so generic page scanning is being used. Make sure the page is not waiting for verification, then retry.

warning_comicCrawler_verification_requir.message: ComicCrawler is waiting for site verification. Complete it in the current manga tab; image extraction will continue automatically once verified.

warning_comicCrawler_browser_target_requ.message: ComicCrawler could not use the current tab. Keep the manga tab open and retry; Browser Client reconnects and registers it automatically in the background.

warning_canvas_snapshot.message: Canvas pages are snapshotted as PNG. A tainted canvas may fail to export.

pageRevisionDescription.message: Successful page retranslations become current automatically. Select pages to retranslate, or choose an older version for administrative recovery.

retranslationInstructionsPlaceholder.message: Example: Keep the character name Koharu untranslated.

retranslationInstructionsHelp.message: The new job inherits the current translator, model, and languages. Instructions are only supported by LLM providers.

textRegionDescription.message: Inspect and correct the detected boxes and exact OCR text retained by this job. Changes across pages can be submitted together.

textRegionEmpty.message: This job contains no detected text regions.

error_text_region_snapshot_unavailable.message: This older job has no retained text-region snapshot.

error_text_region_coordinate_space_unava.message: The backend could not provide reliable image dimensions for this text-region snapshot.

textRegionGeometryHelp.message: Drag the selected box to move it or drag its green handle to resize. Coordinates use source-image pixels within $1 × $2.

textRegionInstructionsPlaceholder.message: Example: Treat Intergalactic Empire as one term.

textRegionCorrectionHelp.message: The correction job inherits the current translation service, model, and languages. Instructions are only supported by compatible providers.

textRegionBatchSummary.message: $1 region(s) across $2 page(s) will be submitted.

error_stale_region_set_revision.message: These text regions have changed since they were loaded. Reload the latest regions and review your corrections again.

error_text_region_source_text_required.message: Corrected OCR text cannot be empty.

error_text_region_geometry_invalid.message: Every coordinate must be a valid number; width and height must be greater than zero.

error_text_region_geometry_out_of_bounds.message: The detection box must stay inside the source image.
